shanghai_stock_exchange_rule.relevant_rule: Competitive-trading buy orders for securities must be 100 shares/units or an integer multiple under rule 3.3.8.

shenzhen_stock_exchange_investor_rule.relevant_rule: Competitive-trading buy orders for Main Board or ChiNext stocks must be 100 shares or an integer multiple.

economic_anchor_verification.scope_limit: The factor is an affordability proxy for ordinary exchange competitive-trading buy orders, not a claim about every security type, block trade, odd-lot disposal, broker fee, investor wealth, or executable portfolio capacity.

candidate.name: intraday_terminal_nominal_share_price_affordability_rank_240m
candidate.mechanism: same-day cross-sectional affordability of one ordinary 100-share board lot from the unadjusted terminal CNY share price
candidate.formula: 1-rank_pct(raw positive finite 15:00 close) on the exact accepted same-day candidate identity universe after validating the exact 240-bar continuous-session grid

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Hold the same-day terminal close cross-section fixed while permuting every stock's earlier 239 closes and all amount, volume, open, high, and low values.
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: return-path, volatility, range, body, wick, gap, activity-profile, transaction-price, VWAP, and market-response definitions

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Multiply one stock-day's entire positive OHLC path by a positive scalar while keeping every relative return, normalized range location, transaction-price ratio, and update time unchanged.
semantic_invariance_checks.campaign073_result: can change because nominal lot notional changes
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: scale-invariant path, normalized-range, entropy, correlation, ratio, and profile definitions

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Change an already-public quarterly value or disclosure date while leaving the terminal close cross-section fixed.
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: accounting-quality, scale, growth-transition, announcement-timing, and peer-crowding definitions

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_round_tenth_close_avoidance_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: also uses raw CNY close values and can carry nominal-price exposure
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: the prior factor counts how 240 closes align with the CNY 0.10 grid; Campaign073 discards all digit identities and path counts after grid validation and measures the single terminal CNY level's same-day affordability rank

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_price_update_share_238m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: tick granularity and nominal price can affect close updates
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: the prior factor counts equality changes over 238 within-half return positions; Campaign073 ignores update incidence and uses one terminal level

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_price_update_clock_entropy_10b_238m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: also derives from the close series
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: the prior factor measures the clock dispersion of update events and is invariant to many level shifts; Campaign073 uses no event clock or entropy

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_close_range_occupancy_entropy_10b
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: the prior factor normalizes each stock-day by its own min/max and measures dwell-state entropy; Campaign073 discards within-day occupancy and preserves cross-stock nominal CNY scale

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_terminal_close_location_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: also depends on the completed-session terminal close
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: the prior factor locates the close inside its own daily high-low range; Campaign073 ignores high/low and ranks the absolute terminal CNY price across stocks

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_transaction_vwap_consensus_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: the prior geometric-to-arithmetic ratio is scale invariant and measures within-day dispersion; Campaign073 reads neither amount nor volume and preserves absolute nominal scale

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_volume_weighted_transaction_price_bowley_skew_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: uses the distribution of executed price levels
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: the prior factor measures volume-weighted within-day distribution asymmetry; Campaign073 uses one unweighted terminal close and no distribution shape

nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: net-profit scale is a point-in-time financial-statement field; Campaign073 uses no financial value, shares outstanding, or market capitalization and directly measures board-lot affordability

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: quarterly_joint_profit_revenue_growth_floor_rank
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: joint accounting growth versus raw terminal nominal CNY price

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_cross_sectional_standardized_return_state_stability_236p
